name: Spider-shell forge
description: A squat cement firepot clad in plates of black spider shell, with a grate, an air pipe and two iron handles. It burns hot enough to melt down strange metals, and two people can carry it.
notes: A cement bowl 250 mm across and 200 mm deep inside eight black chitin plates with red seams, 300 mm across the rim and 230 mm tall; a grate and coals inside, an air pipe on +x, handles front and back and three glowing runes on the front. The round body, pipe and handles leave air in the bounding box. Kept as a carried tool rather than a workstation because the forge is portable; if Deadvox makes it a placed station, add `workstation: { id: 'spider_shell_forge', qualities: { smelting: 2, forging: 1 } }`. The coals are glow-flame; a dull coal-black finish would read better than plastic-charcoal.

name: Sack of heatproof mortar
description: A stiff paper sack of grey mortar with its top rolled shut and a pale blue sign printed on a red band. Mixed and laid, it holds against heat that would crack common brick.
notes: Loose powder, modelled in the paper sack a player would pick up: 110 by 70 mm and 190 mm tall with its top rolled twice and a little grey spill on the roll. The paper adds nothing worth counting to the mass.

name: Shimmerwool tuft
description: A loose cluster of fine crimped wool, pale and soft, its lock tips almost white. It can be felted into patches or spun into yarn.
notes: A clump about 170 by 110 mm and 76 mm high built from overlapping balls, with paler lock tips. A fluffy clump fills little of its box. It is a tool with no qualities, so none are given. A soft fibre or fleece finish with a faint sheen would read better than fur-pale with feather-white tips.
